Legend Mark Chronology

Every Legend mark NexusTK ever inscribed on a character, placed on a real-world timeline — and, where the game brought a mark back, each separate run it was issued in.

Recovered from 27,475 archived users.nexustk.com character pages. In-game stamps resolved through the 8× calendar: 1 year = 45.65 real days, Yuri 0 = 1996-02-13, re-epoched −136 years at 2013-02-11.

Marks entering the game, by year

A first appearance is the earliest run of a mark big enough to be a real cohort. A re-issue run is that same mark handed out again after going quiet. Click a bar to jump to that year.

First appearance Re-issue run
2,866 of 2,866 marks

How a date is arrived at. Most marks carry an in-game stamp (Yuri 66, Spring); those resolve directly. Marks that never carry one — Novice fisherman, the anniversary marks — are dated by position instead: a legend lists marks oldest-first, so an unstamped mark is bracketed by the stamped marks around it. Those rows are marked estimated and give the latest date the mark can have been introduced.

Two caveats. The year counter was re-epoched by −136 in Feb 2013, so a bare Yuri 24 is either 1999 or 2016; a handful of legends resolve to the wrong side of that split, which is why a first appearance is taken from the first substantial cohort rather than the single earliest sighting. And the archive samples the game — a mark's run boundaries are as sharp as the pages that survived.

Built from legend_marks.json and legend_mark_events.jsonl.
